answer.reason: The verses tell two things Urijah did at King Ahaz's order, building the altar and serving at it.

clauses.english: built an altar from the pattern Ahaz sent from Damascus
clauses.quote: Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent

clauses.english: carried out Ahaz's orders for the offerings on the great altar
clauses.quote: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

doubts: ISA 8:2 names Uriah the priest as a witness; the verses do not say he is the same man, so it is left out.
